faq.shipping: Orders are processed within 24 hours and shipped via Express Air Priority. Metro deliveries arrive in 2–3 business days. Free standard shipping applies to all orders over ₹2,999.
faq.returns: We offer a 14-day zero-friction exchange and return policy. Items must be unworn with tags attached. Reverse pickup is scheduled straight from your doorstep.
faq.sizing: Our pieces feature architectural oversized cuts designed with drop shoulders and generous chest volume. If you prefer the intended streetwear drape, take your true size. For a more standard fit, size down one.
